payload.text: **LESSONS candidates from the late close-out (2026-09-16 night), vc's call at a fold.** (n) Two full bats suites run concurrently under one $TMPDIR: dc's run lost 3 tests to "unexpected EOF" in bats' preprocessed .src copy while vc's run of the same sha executed all 1213 -- run one full suite at a time per machine, or give each its own TMPDIR. (o) A load-time refusal added to a shared lib (lib/builtins requiring lib/helpers) found the one test loader the builder's grep missed only in the full suite -- grep for loaders by what they source, not by the calling shape. (p) Replacing a case statement with a split list silently took on the caller's IFS; a refactor to "data" changes what the code reads from its environment. (q) Hardening one of two copies of a question (the stamp) made the unhardened copy (the publish gate) reachable into a state it was built to refuse -- when one copy of a check is hardened, find every other asker in the same pass. (r) vc sent a TAKE on work dc had already committed; check git log before announcing a take, not after.
